description: This file defines functions and types for processing streaming reply directives, including parsing chunks, handling silent replies, and accumulating directives for streaming responses.

classes.name: PendingReplyState
classes.description: Tracks the state of a pending reply, including optional explicit ID, whether current reply is seen, and if it has a tag.

classes.name: ConsumeOptions
classes.description: Options for consuming a chunk, including whether it's the final chunk and a silent token.

methods.name: splitTrailingDirective
methods.description: Splits a text into main text and trailing directive tail based on last occurrence of "[[" and matching "]]".

methods.name: parseChunk
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a structured reply chunk, handling media, directives, and silent reply detection.

methods.name: hasRenderableContent
methods.description: Checks if a parsed reply has outbound reply content or audio as voice.

methods.name: createStreamingDirectiveAccumulator
methods.description: Creates an accumulator object to process streaming reply directives, maintaining context across chunks.
